cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageRack to store boxes and trays which have their own floor
Drawers are not included:
![Inside](static/samples/StorageRack-2.jpg) ![Back wall details](static/samples/StorageRack-3.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageRack --x 100 --depth 200 --sh '50*3' --rail 30 --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --top_edge F --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageRack --sh --outside --reference --labels
